This photograph shows the signing ceremony for the North Atlantic Treaty on April 4, 1949. The treaty created the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), a mutual defense alliance between the United States, Canada, and ten Western European nations.

(Photograph, April 4, 1949. Public Domain.)

What was the PRIMARY purpose of the alliance created by the treaty shown being signed in this photograph?
items.stemEs: ¿Cuál era el propósito PRINCIPAL de la alianza creada por el tratado mostrado?

choices.text: To establish free trade among Western nations
To create a unified European government
To dismantle colonial empires in Asia and Africa
To provide collective defense against Soviet aggression in Europe

This photograph shows the NATO treaty signing, April 4, 1949.

(Photograph, 1949. Public Domain.)

How did the creation of NATO, shown in this photograph, represent a departure from traditional American foreign policy?
items.stemEs: ¿Cómo representó la creación de la OTAN una ruptura con la política exterior tradicional estadounidense?

choices.text: NATO was a temporary agreement that expired after five years
It was the first peacetime military alliance in American history
The alliance required no military commitment from the United States
The United States had long maintained peacetime military alliances in Europe

items.stem: How did the formation of NATO and the Warsaw Pact reflect the ideological competition between the United States and the Soviet Union during the Cold War?
items.stemEs: ¿Cómo reflejó la formación de la OTAN y el Pacto de Varsovia la competencia ideológica entre Estados Unidos y la Unión Soviética durante la Guerra Fría?

choices.text: The alliances reflected agreement between superpowers on the need for collective disarmament
choices.textEs: Las alianzas reflejaron el acuerdo entre las superpotencias sobre la necesidad del desarme colectivo

choices.text: Both alliances were formed primarily for economic cooperation rather than military defense
choices.textEs: Ambas alianzas se formaron principalmente para la cooperación económica y no para la defensa militar

choices.text: They split Europe into rival military blocs, one capitalist and one communist
choices.textEs: Dividieron Europa en bloques militares opuestos alineados con el capitalismo estadounidense o el comunismo soviético

choices.text: NATO and the Warsaw Pact were created jointly to prevent a third world war between smaller nations
choices.textEs: La OTAN y el Pacto de Varsovia fueron creados conjuntamente para evitar una tercera guerra mundial entre naciones más pequeñas

items.stem:
Use the photograph to answer the question.

This photograph shows a U.S. Air Force C-54 Skymaster cargo plane flying low over a crowd of German civilians as it approaches Tempelhof Airport in Berlin during the summer of 1948.

(Photograph, 1948. U.S. Air Force.)

To what extent did early Cold War confrontations like the one shown in this photograph shape the formation of military alliances in Europe?
items.stemEs: ¿En qué medida las confrontaciones de la Guerra Fría como la mostrada en esta fotografía moldearon las alianzas militares en Europa?

choices.text: The crisis led both the U.S. and Soviet Union to immediately reduce their military presence in Europe
choices.textEs: La crisis llevó tanto a EE. UU. como a la Unión Soviética a reducir de inmediato su presencia militar en Europa

choices.text: The crisis had no lasting impact because the Soviet Union voluntarily ended the blockade
choices.textEs: La crisis no tuvo un impacto duradero porque la Unión Soviética levantó voluntariamente el bloqueo

choices.text: The crisis was resolved through the United Nations, proving that international organizations alone could maintain peace
choices.textEs: La crisis se resolvió a través de las Naciones Unidas, lo que demostró que las organizaciones internacionales podían mantener la paz por sí solas

choices.text: The crisis accelerated the creation of NATO as Western nations sought collective security against Soviet aggression
choices.textEs: La crisis aceleró la creación de la OTAN, ya que las naciones occidentales buscaron seguridad colectiva frente a la agresión soviética

Use the photograph to answer the question.

This photograph shows the NATO treaty signing, 1949.

(Photograph, 1949. Public Domain.)

Analyze how NATO fit into the broader containment strategy of the United States during the early Cold War.
items.stemEs: Analice cómo la OTAN encajó en la estrategia más amplia de contención de EE.UU. durante la Guerra Fría temprana.

choices.text: NATO was the military component of containment — complementing the Truman Doctrine's political commitment and the Marshall Plan's economic support to prevent Soviet expansion into Western Europe
NATO was unrelated to containment and was created solely for economic cooperation
NATO replaced the containment policy with a strategy of direct military confrontation with the Soviet Union
The containment strategy relied entirely on nuclear weapons and did not include alliances
